title: Offline Field Approval System Design
gradingCriteria: Avoids proposing a CRDT platform rewrite for the six-week MVP; chooses versioned drafts, server-side conflict detection, and explicit human resolution for approval conflicts.
Separates mutable current inspection state from append-only audit events retained for 7 years.
Handles supervisor approval while inspector is offline by treating approval as a versioned transition and blocking/flagging stale offline edits rather than silently overwriting.
Includes local durable queue on iPad with attachment upload state, idempotency keys, retry, and visible sync status.
Addresses PII photos with encryption, scoped access, retention/legal-hold semantics, and product-level redaction/hiding for deletion requests.
Uses existing Postgres + S3 + queue worker rather than a new synchronization platform, and states concrete MVP limits and open questions.
